articles.summary: Mayville Engineering Company (NYSE: MEC) (the “Company” or “MEC”), a leading value-added provider of design, prototyping and manufacturing solutions serving diverse end markets, today announced results for the three and twelve-months ended December 31, 2025. FOURTH QUARTER 2025 RESULTS (All comparisons versus the prior-year period) Net sales of $134.3 million, or +10.7% y/y Net loss of $4.4 million, or ($0.22) per diluted share; Non-GAAP Adjusted Diluted EPS of ($0.08) Adjusted EBITDA of $6.3 mi
articles.title: Mayville Engineering Company Announces Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results
